{{Quote|The Empire wanted the Barrager so they could hold Balmorra forever. Now I see the Republic does, too.|Carsiri|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Carsiri''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] who lived during the [[Galactic War]]. On [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], he was forced into working on the [[Barrager]] weapon for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], but defected to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] at first opportunity. He helped [[Cassius Madine]] locate the weapon and after his overseer [[Darth Minax]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]], assumed the Republic would destroy the weapon. He was disappointed when Madine wanted the keep it, because the Barrager could damage the entire planet if ever used.

==Behind the scenes==
===Gameplay alternatives===
If the player took the dark side option back at the [[Gorinth Brig]] to preserve the Barrager's files instead of freeing the prisoners, Carsiri is killed by Darth Minax upon the player's arrival in the Barrager Laboratory, impaled through the stomach by her lightsaber and kicked down below the laboratory's platform. An unidentified Barrager scientist takes on his role in asking that the weapon be destroyed and fulfil Carsiri's dying wish.
